about: home: the order the installed builds (BKCB6 113, BKCB 48, CBNYC 45) draw. home@2: the order builds from 114 / 49 / 46 draw (they read home@2 when it is here, else home). The Your block fold's id changes whenever home.json changes (myblock-open, myblock-open2, ...): the installed builds keep a fold's open state by its id across a pack refresh, and a refresh that lands on the code's fallback list leaves it shut; a new id makes a fresh fold that starts open.
